research_question: Does an irregular-time-aware JEPA representation improve held-out transient ranking/classification relative to a time-agnostic JEPA and simple photometric baselines under an object-disjoint frozen evaluation?

candidate_dataset.name: Unblinded Data for PLAsTiCC Classification Challenge

source_evidence.record_reference: PLASTICC Team, The PLASTICC Data Set, arXiv:1810.00001

preoutcome_split_intent.development: PLAsTiCC published training surface only, subject to an exact object-disjoint internal train/validation manifest frozen before model comparison.
preoutcome_split_intent.candidate_confirmatory: PLAsTiCC published test surface only if independent review establishes that its now-public unblinded labels have not entered method/threshold development and an outcome-blind loader can enforce label isolation.
preoutcome_split_intent.fallback_if_confirmatory_freshness_fails: If confirmatory freshness fails, treat PLAsTiCC as development/external-characterization only and select a separate genuinely unobserved astronomy benchmark before making confirmatory claims.

required_independent_review_before_any_h: confirm the Zenodo v1 record and every retained file checksum against the live official record
record applicable licensing/usage terms; the observed Zenodo record does not display a license value
determine whether public unblinding or prior team exposure makes the original PLAsTiCC test labels unsuitable for confirmatory use
review the exact parser so heldout labels/classes are inaccessible to feature fitting, model fitting, early stopping, threshold selection, architecture selection, and hyperparameter search
freeze exact object/split identities and byte receipts after download without inspecting heldout outcome summaries
freeze the primary metric, uncertainty rule, seeds, operating point, and practical-effect threshold before model outcomes
confirm that a simulated PLAsTiCC result will be described as simulated-benchmark evidence rather than real-sky clinical/operational validation
claim_boundary: This artifact selects a provenance-pinned candidate for the Space-JEPA astronomy track; it is not a dataset freeze, not proof of freshness, not execution authorization, and not an astronomy result. A positive PLAsTiCC result would support only a simulated transient-classification claim unless separately confirmed on real observations.
